name: cache-status
description:
Prompt cache and token usage reporting for the current Codex session.

Aliases: @cache-status, cache status, cachestat, prompt cache, cache hit rate.

Use Cache Status when the user asks how much prompt caching is being used, what the cache hit rate is, how many tokens were cached vs. sent fresh, or wants the built-in /status numbers plus cache detail. It reads the session rollout that Codex already writes locally, so it works offline and needs no network access.

The built-in /status panel shows context usage and rate limits but omits cached_input_tokens; this plugin surfaces exactly that missing dimension.

interface.shortDescription: See prompt cache hit rate and token usage
interface.longDescription: Cache Status reports how much of your input is being served from the prompt cache. It reads the session rollout Codex writes under ~/.codex/sessions and shows cache hit rate, cached vs. fresh input tokens, context window usage, per-turn cache history, and rate limits — the cache detail the built-in /status panel receives but does not display.
defaultPrompt: How much prompt caching am I using?
Show my cache hit rate for this session
